pitfalls: REST PUT of article alone can drop tenant on published flash-news-item rows (lifecycle auto-tenant only for admin editor users).
After linking, call POST /api/migration/fix-published with uid api::flash-news-item.flash-news-item and tenantDocumentId — omit publishedAt to avoid double-publishing drafts.
Relation must point at the published article row (not draft) or populate returns article:null.
Cloud publish-only articles: PUT article by documentId fails (locale null not found); use numeric entry id (script does this).
Scope: flash-news-items article relation + tenant repair only. Do not modify other content types.
